changes: Selected two representative curves from original Figure4A; not labelled ground states.
Digitized published raster curves; no fitted model potentials or extrapolation.
Retained source common normalization and published -0.24eV simulation shift.
Display-sampled visible experimental curve centers with open circles; occluded values remain absent.
Removed other state curves, electronic term labels, sticks and inset for clarity.
New composition, colors, German labels and source/license credit.

scientific_scope.PES_reference: Original shared relative energy reference in Figure4A retained. Blue selected solid doublet, red selected solid singlet; neither called the full ground-state potential.
scientific_scope.relationship: Spectrum includes transitions involving multiple states; not produced solely from the two selected plotted PES curves.
scientific_scope.data_status: Figure digitizations; not original numerical PES or raw instrumental samples. Digital reading uncertainty and unresolved values in data metadata.
